children.name: Georgeantha hexandra B.G.Briggs & L.A.S.Johnson
children.description: Georgeantha is a monotypic genus of herbaceous, rhizomatous plant endemic to Western Australia. The sole species is Georgeantha hexandra.

children.name: Ecdeiocolea monostachya F.Muell.
children.description: Ecdeiocolea monostachya is a species of grass-like plant in the family Ecdeiocoleaceae native to Western Australia.

children.name: Ecdeiocolea rigens B.G.Briggs
children.description: A rush-like (graminoid) perennial endemic to Western Australia, one of only two species in the genus Ecdeiocolea (family Ecdeiocoleaceae). Described by Barbara G. Briggs in 2011, it is a close relative of the type species E. monostachya; the family is of major phylogenetic interest as one of the nearest living relatives of the true grasses (Poaceae), to which Ecdeiocolea is sister.
